$comment: A data-* name one edit from exactly one Datastar attribute, free or Pro, where the author meant Datastar (the attribute is written bare as that one is, its value names a signal or an action, or the name has a key), in an HTML string and in the attributes of the kotlinx.html DSL, and what attributes["data-..."] = "..." is checked as, judged by both editors alike; html.json holds the same names in a document. The format is the corpus's.

cases.name: a name one edit from a Datastar attribute in the attributes of the DSL, hinted where the author meant Datastar
cases.source:
import kotlinx.html.*

fun FlowContent.card() {
    div {
        attributes["data-persits"] = ""
        attributes["data-computd"] = "@get('/x')"
        attributes["data-shwo"] = "\$open"
        attributes["data-no:click"] = "x()"
        attributes["data-indicatorr"] = "y"
        attributes["data-slow"] = ""
        attributes["data-test"] = "login"
        attributes["data-kind"] = "x"
        attributes["data-theme"] = ""
        attributes["data-id"] = "1"
        attributes["data-value"] = "2"
    }
}
